name: Yoda's Jedi Attack Fighter
description: A green starfighter piloted by the Jedi Master Yoda that strongly resembles a a downsized Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor at some point during the Clone Wars. A key difference between this fighter and its more commonplace look-alike is the presence of onboard hyperdrive, located in nacelles that are folded under the fighter when not in use. These nacelles also provide a location for two missile launchers.
